resources.string: Tap a message twice to react; one tap then opens the menu a moment later
double tap, double-tap, tap twice, quick reaction, react, reaction, like, heart

A double tap on a message sends this reaction, and another double tap takes it back. It is your Telegram default reaction, so the official apps on your other devices use it too. Where a chat does not allow it, your quick reaction is sent instead.
